items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: You don't know Jimmy Kennell do you? No. He was a little kid too. He was a little fella too.

ctx.x: What was his name, Mom? Kennell? Yeah, Jimmy Kennell. Jimmy Kennell?
You don't know Jimmy Kennell do you? No. He was a little kid too. He was a little fella too.
Jimmy Kennell. He played cornet too. He played with him too?
